title: Peer-Reviewed Deliberative Language-Agent Search
purpose: Reproduce the peer-reviewed core mechanism lineage from reasoning/acting and reflection through deliberate search, world-model planning, interactive MCTS and process-reward-guided search.

scope_rule.core: A node must be a qualifying peer-reviewed conference/journal publication and introduce or materially change a transferable reasoning/search/agent-control mechanism.
scope_rule.satellite: Application descendants are added only after a qualifying peer-reviewed publication is verified.
scope_rule.completeness: Continuously audit flagship venue proceedings and forward/backward citations. Preprint-only nodes are not part of the formal lineage.
scope_rule.reproduction_unit: Exact publication + source cut + benchmark/environment cut + model/prompt/config + search/trial/token/cost budget + baselines + metrics/statistics + fidelity deltas.

platform_rule.promotion_gate: Promote a mechanism upstream only after repeated pressure from multiple independent peer-reviewed nodes demonstrates method-independent semantics.

core_nodes.paper: ReAct: Synergizing Reasoning and Acting in Language Models
Reflexion: Language Agents with Verbal Reinforcement Learning

parents.edge: adds retry-level verbal self-reflection and episodic verbal memory

core_nodes.paper: Tree of Thoughts: Deliberate Problem Solving with Large Language Models
Reasoning with Language Model is Planning with World Model
Language Agent Tree Search Unifies Reasoning, Acting, and Planning in Language Models

parents.edge: branching deliberate search and LM heuristic evaluation

core_nodes.paper: QLASS: Boosting Language Agent Inference via Q-Guided Stepwise Search

parents.edge: replaces trajectory-only guidance with learned stepwise Q-value/process-reward guidance over a reasoning tree

execution_protocol: Verify qualifying peer-reviewed publication identity before coding.
Freeze exact publication/source version and paper-era repository commit/tag.
Extract algorithm, prompt, state/action/observation, reflection/memory, stopping and search hyperparameters.
Freeze benchmark version, split, environment build and evaluation code.
Freeze model/provider/revision, decoding parameters, seeds and model-facing history projection.
Reproduce baselines, metrics, ablations and statistical aggregation needed for the published claim.
Implement scientific semantics under research/reproductions and consume native Noetrium contracts.
Run fidelity tests, source-cut smokes, pilot experiments and matched experiments.
Bind every result to immutable source/model/environment/prompt/config/evaluation cuts.
Promote upstream only method-independent mechanisms demanded by multiple publications.
immediate_platform_pressure_hypotheses: branch/fork/checkpoint identity and environment snapshot semantics
reproducible stochastic expansion with seed and sampling provenance
search frontier checkpoint/resume without a second durability authority
paper-level reflection memory versus platform durable evidence

execution_mode.rule: All eligible core reproduction lanes advance independently and in parallel. Preprint-only descendants do not consume formal pressure capacity.
